creative_brief.emotional_promise: One pearl, two poses, and a visible little vault guided by a single deliberate press.
creative_brief.format_rationale: The compact two-piece product needs only a cover-level state reveal and one reverse-side setup, operation, reset, care, and safety sequence; a two-sided card keeps all guidance visible without a booklet.
creative_brief.physical_format: Double-sided 5 by 7 inch portrait owner card
teaching_arc: Recognize the low and tall endpoint poses
Inventory the open-mouth shell and loose pearl drum
Seat the visible pearl in an exposed lip saddle
Press the broad rear ridge forward and down
Use the opposite ridge to aim back toward the first pose
Reset gently, never force, then dry-wipe and store together
typography: Display and step headings: Bitstream Vera Sans Bold
Instructions and notes: Bitstream Vera Sans
creative_brief.visual_motif: Broad rounded clam-lip panels, pearl-number badges, and a direct LOW-to-TALL arrow echo the product's open shell and visible rolling element.

findings: The initial cover's disconnected arrow fragments did not clearly tie the press action to the LOW-to-TALL state change.
The initial reset, care, and safety paragraph was dense for rapid scanning.
resolved_changes: Replaced the fragments with one labeled PRESS REAR RIDGE arrow running directly from LOW toward TALL.
Reworked the dark support panel into separate RESET, STOP, and CARE lines with the never-force and loose-part warnings emphasized.
